Market today: The mood is strongly bullish on AI, driven by Nvidia's blockbuster earnings and other AI-related surges. This is a clear tailwind for your tech/chip heavy book. However, underlying rate hikes in Asia signal continued inflation concerns, which could eventually temper growth stock enthusiasm.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.18%) and SPAL (-40.36%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and your losses are amplified by margin. SMH (-12.67%) and QQQI (-3.95%) are also down, while CRWD (+5.18%) is up but flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions for further decay. Also, monitor how global rate hikes might start to impact tech valuations if the trend continues.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged losers while enjoying the AI momentum.
plays: Cut SOXL: Your -54.18% loss on this leveraged, decaying ETF is a major capital drain. Consider exiting to preserve margin.
Re-evaluate SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is already down -40.36%. Its volatility and decay make it a high-risk holding on margin.
Trim CRWD: Scanner suggests trimming your +5.18% gain. Taking some profit can reduce concentration and free up margin.
